description: AXIOM aesthetic identity taxonomy for the reference corpus. Separates primary aesthetic DNA from technical knowledge sources to prevent identity blurring.

primary.description: AXIOM's core aesthetic DNA. All referenceDistanceScore (R-01 gate) measurements are computed against this profile only — NOT the global average.
aestheticTraits: Beethovenian architecture: motivic inevitability, dramatic contrast, long-range tonal conflict and resolution
Schubertian lyricism: song-like melody, harmonic wandering, mediant color shifts, major/minor bittersweet ambiguity
primary.note: Mixing other composers into this group will dilute AXIOM's identity. Add only Beethoven and Schubert works here.

counterpoint.description: Voice-leading discipline and contrapuntal technique. Used as a technical benchmark for voice independence scoring, NOT for stylistic identity.
counterpoint.note: Bach is a technical textbook, not part of AXIOM's primary aesthetic lineage.

classical_proportion.description: Classical phrase clarity, balanced periods, and formal proportion. Reference for phrase-length regularity metrics.
classical_proportion.note: Mozart/Haydn teach proportion as craft knowledge. They are not AXIOM's identity.

piano_idiom.description: Piano keyboard texture, figurations, and cantabile writing. Auxiliary reference for piano lane idiom benchmarks.
piano_idiom.note: Chopin piano textures are a knowledge source for the piano lane, not AXIOM's compositional identity.

motivic_density_reference.description: Dense motivic development and chromatic voice leading. Comparison reference for motivic complexity upper bound.
motivic_density_reference.note: Brahms is a future comparison reference. Do not blend into primary identity — AXIOM should lean Beethoven/Schubert, not Brahms.

future_concerto_texture.description: Long-span orchestral/concerto texture reference. Future reference only — not part of the current identity or active corpus.
future_concerto_texture.note: Rachmaninoff is a long-term future reference for concerto texture. Not yet active.

notIncluded.reason: The following composers are excluded from the current corpus to prevent identity dilution. They may be added as separate technical references in future phases.

beethoven.description: AXIOM's structural and motivic DNA. Primary identity source.

schubert.description: AXIOM's lyrical and harmonic color DNA. Primary identity source.

bach.description: Voice-leading and counterpoint validator. Bach is a craft textbook, not AXIOM's aesthetic identity.

chopin.description: Piano idiom validator only. Chopin keyboard texture as craft knowledge.

brahms.description: Motivic density comparison reference only. Not part of AXIOM's primary identity.

rachmaninoff.description: Future concerto texture reference. Not yet active in current corpus.
